_comment: A phoenix is loyal to those who show it loyalty. It eats nothing a wizard can offer, so trust is not fed: a player who kills something that has just hurt a phoenix earns its notice (PhoenixEntity, +20), calm company keeps it growing, and a single blow undoes it. At 60 it weeps healing tears over its person; at 80 it gives a feather now and then; at 90 it follows.
